description: Collect public Pinterest Pins, profiles, boards, board sections, comments, idea feeds and search results. Every field is optional; choose a mode or let Auto-detect route your links.

boardUrls.description: Public board links or username/board paths. A three-part board-section link is routed to that section's Pins.
boardUrls.title: Board or section URLs

commerceOnly.description: Keep only Pins with source-backed product, price, or shopping metadata.
commerceOnly.title: Shoppable Pins only

enrichDetails.description: Check each collection Pin's public detail page for more accurate creator, engagement, link, and media fields. Slower and uses more requests.
enrichDetails.title: Enrich Pin details

excludeAds.description: Exclude Pins that Pinterest marks as promoted or sponsored.
excludeAds.title: Exclude promoted Pins

ideaUrls.description: Public idea-topic links such as /ideas/beauty/935541271955/. Pinterest exposes a list-only feed capped at about 17 Pins.
ideaUrls.title: Idea topic URLs

imageOnly.description: Exclude Pins that Pinterest identifies as video.
imageOnly.title: Images only

includeComments.description: Add one real public comment row per collected numeric Pin. Comment rows count toward Maximum records.
includeComments.title: Include Pin comments

keywords.description: One or more words or phrases for the search modes.
keywords.title: Search words

maxComments.description: Maximum public comment rows to add per Pin when comments are enabled.
maxComments.title: Maximum comments per Pin

maxItems.description: Maximum number of emitted records, including comment and section rows. Set to 0 for no user cap.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

maxPages.description: Maximum feed pages per search, profile, or board. 0 follows Pinterest's cursors until the source ends.
maxPages.title: Maximum pages

minCreatorFollowers.description: 0 means no minimum. Keep Pins only when Pinterest supplies a creator follower count at or above this value.
minCreatorFollowers.title: Minimum creator followers

minSaves.description: 0 means no minimum. For a positive value, keep only Pins where Pinterest supplies a numeric save count at or above it.
minSaves.title: Minimum saves

mode.description: Choose a collection type. Auto-detect accepts mixed public Pinterest Pin, profile, board, board-section, search and idea links.
enumTitles: Pins inside a board or section
mode.title: What to collect

pinUrls.description: Public Pin links, numeric Pin IDs, or opaque feed IDs. Opaque IDs are kept as list rows without a detail page.
pinUrls.title: Pin URLs or IDs

proxyConfiguration.description: Leave empty for direct-first collection with the actor's automatic fallback. A supplied proxy is used only after a direct empty or blocked response.
proxyConfiguration.title: Optional proxy configuration

requireOutboundLink.description: Keep only Pins with a public destination link supplied by Pinterest.
requireOutboundLink.title: Require destination link

resolveNumericIds.description: When a creator feed contains only opaque IDs, read the creator's public RSS feed to recover openable numeric Pin IDs.
resolveNumericIds.title: Recover numeric creator Pin IDs

startUrls.description: Pin, profile, board, board-section, search and idea links for Auto-detect.
startUrls.title: Mixed Pinterest URLs

verifiedOnly.description: Keep only rows that Pinterest explicitly marks as verified.
verifiedOnly.title: Verified accounts only

title: Pinterest Data Extractor Input
